subject: [PATCH RESEND 4/7] locking/percpu-rwsem: track holders of opted-in percpu_rw_semaphores

2026-09-24.patch_summary: This patch adds a feature to track the holders of percpu_rw_semaphores, which are used in various Linux kernel components such as filesystem freeze and async writes. The patch introduces a new function `percpu_rwsem_track_holder()` that allows opting-in percpu_rw_semaphores for holder tracking. It also updates several functions to count the lock holders correctly, ensuring that tasks are not preemptible while holding the lock without being counted. This feature is enabled by CONFIG_TRACK_LOCK_HOLDERS and adds a new field `tracked` to the percpu_rw_semaphore structure.
